name: Brass Juggernaut
body:
This brass sculpture looks something like a huge lion from the shoulders down, but its head is a short cone of brass, widening to a 20-foot-diameter head.

Brass Juggernaut
CR 7

XP 3,200
N Huge construct
Init -2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception -5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 6, flat-footed 16 (-2 Dex, +10 natural, -2 size)
hp 78 (7d10+40)
Fort +2, Ref +0, Will -3
Defensive Abilities hardness 10; Immune construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee slam +15 (2d6+15)
Special Attacks trample (2d6+15, DC 23)

STATISTICS

Str 31, Dex 6, Con —, Int —, Wis 1, Cha 1
Base Atk +7; CMB +19; CMD 27
SQ construction points (4; metal, trample)

Construction

CL 7th; Price 15,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct; Spells animate objects, permanency; Skill Craft (sculptures); Cost 7,500 gp
